# Fleet classifier fixtures (CIP-000A)

| Repo | Role |
|---|---|
| `v901` | Published, missing posts workflow |
| `v902` | Published, matching `pmlint-posts.yml` |
| `v903` | Published, custom workflow mentioning `check_posts` |
| `v904` | Unpublished (skip for posts campaign) |
| `v905` | Unpublished, missing intake workflow |
| `v906` | Published (skip for intake campaign) |

Published fixtures use `.pmfleet-published` and/or `_posts/` so tests need no git remotes.
